title: acer amoenum f. palmatipartitum
intro: Acer amoenum f. palmatipartitum, commonly known as a type of maple tree, is a plant species native to China. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree with palmate leaves divided into several lobes. The plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Acer amoenum f. palmatipartitum include sedative, analgesic, and antipyretic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
